label: extension

args.subject: Group stay enquiry — 10 people in June
args.body:
Hello City Hub Tokyo team,

I'm organising a group stay for 10 people and would like to ask about your availability in June. Could you please let me know which dates you could accommodate our group, along with available room configurations, group rates, and any minimum-stay requirements?

Thank you for your help.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson

final_text: Sent an email to **groups@cityhub-tokyo.jp**, the group-bookings address mentioned in the review, asking about availability for **10 people in June**, room configurations, group rates, and minimum-stay requirements.
